name: Offline field notebook
lineage: new — the LLP 0129 local-first floor had no 0102 counterpart

scenarios.fact: Exact deterministic dataset and the three personas exist in the fresh target or arm-isolated namespace.
Alice and Bob read the authenticated team workspace; Mallory cannot read or subscribe to it.
scenarios.planBullet: authenticated team workspaces and outsider denial

scenarios.fact: Structured records carry assignments, stable ordering, and due dates through create, edit, and reorder transitions.
scenarios.planBullet: structured records, assignments, ordering, due dates, and attachments

scenarios.fact: A record attachment is uploaded, authorized, delivered, and deleted.
scenarios.planBullet: structured records, assignments, ordering, due dates, and attachments

scenarios.fact: A previously opened client cold-restarts the browser with the backend unreachable and presents the notebook.
scenarios.planBullet: cold browser restart with the backend unreachable

scenarios.fact: Retained protected reads carry an honest freshness state while the backend is unreachable.
scenarios.planBullet: retained protected reads with honest freshness state

scenarios.fact: Queued create and update operations survive a client restart while still offline.
scenarios.planBullet: durable queued create and update operations across restart

scenarios.fact: Concurrent conflicting edits produce a visible deterministic outcome.
scenarios.planBullet: concurrent conflicting edits with a visible deterministic outcome

scenarios.fact: Reconnect settles the queued work exactly once, without duplication.
Authorization loss retires protected local state per the documented contract.
scenarios.planBullet: authorization loss and logout retirement of protected local state

scenarios.fact: Logout retires protected local state per the documented contract.
scenarios.planBullet: authorization loss and logout retirement of protected local state

scenarios.fact: A deterministic export of the workspace is produced and verified.
Only exact fresh targets or the arm-owned namespace are cleaned up; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
